title: Now Accepting Bitcoin: Coljac Café Bitcoin Hub with 40+ Nearby Missouri Merchants
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Now Accepting Bitcoin: Coljac Café Bitcoin Hub with 40+ Nearby Missouri Merchants Coljac Café Bitcoin acceptance in Farmington, MO sparked a bitcoin corridor connecting 30 independent farmers, diners, and main-street merchants across Missouri. This post Now Accepting Bitcoin: Coljac Café Bitcoin Hub with 40+ Nearby Missouri Merchants first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Vagabond .
